verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs link a full OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec for the Cloud Agents API. A same-day probe confirmed it downloads as live YAML (HTTP 200), and a separate OpenAPI spec for the Origin API is also live, alongside an llms.txt index of the API docs. missing for 10: no evidence of downloadable specs for the Admin, Analytics, AI Code Tracking, or Bugbot APIs, and the specs that exist cover beta/alpha APIs (Cloud Agents beta, Origin v1alpha1).
